title: Mark or unmark a complaint
purpose: Mark a ticket as a complaint, or (supervisors only) remove that mark, always with a reason.
summary: Mark a ticket as a complaint so it gets a decision, a record and an independent review. Only a supervisor can unmark one. Both need a reason.

tasks.title: Mark a ticket as a complaint
steps: From the ticket's [[More]] menu choose [[Mark as a complaint]].
Write the [[Reason]] and select [[Mark as a complaint]].

tasks.title: Unmark a complaint (supervisor)
steps: From the ticket's [[More]] menu choose [[Unmark complaint]].

good_to_know: Any staff role can mark a complaint, but only a supervisor can unmark one. Others are refused, and do not see the menu choice.
A ticket is also a complaint automatically when its category is a complaint category. Changing the category later does not unmark it.
A complaint closes only after an independent review by a supervisor who did not record the decision and was never assigned the ticket.
A closed ticket cannot be marked or unmarked.

sections.title: Fields and actions
paragraphs: One page serves both actions: it marks when the ticket is not a complaint and unmarks when it is. The heading and the button say which. The form remembers the version of the ticket you opened; if it changed since, saving is refused and you reload.

items.label: Reason
items.description: Required. Why the ticket is, or is no longer, a complaint. Kept in the audit history and on the timeline event.

items.label: Mark as a complaint
items.description: Marks the ticket a complaint and confirms Marked as a complaint. A Complaint badge and the Complaint section then appear on the ticket page, and the ticket shows in the Complaints views.

items.label: Unmark complaint
items.description: Supervisors only. Removes the mark and confirms No longer a complaint. The recorded decision and findings stay in the audit history.

items.label: Cancel
items.description: Returns to the ticket without changing anything.

items.label: Who may do what
items.description: Marking: every active staff role who may read the ticket. Unmarking: supervisors, including the admin role. A non-supervisor who opens the unmark page directly is refused.

items.label: Refusals
items.description: A ticket that is already in the chosen state ("Nothing to change."), for example when someone else marked it first, and a closed ticket ("A closed ticket cannot change.").

items.label: Category flag
items.description: A category can be flagged as a complaint category by the laboratory. Tickets logged in it start as complaints. Marking by hand is for other categories.
